candidates.change_summary: Change owner() to return a different stored address by returning the zero address when _owner is nonzero (flips to zero), otherwise return _owner.
Remove the require that newOwner is non-zero (allows transferring ownership to zero address), changing resulting owner after transferOwnership.
Change the transfer to set owner to msg.sender instead of newOwner, causing owner to remain the caller rather than the specified newOwner.
Add a guard that prevents transferring ownership unless newOwner equals current owner, so transferOwnership becomes a no-op unless same address provided.
Change paused() to return the negation of _paused, so callers observe opposite paused state.
Change paused() to always return true regardless of _paused internal state.
Change paused() to always return false regardless of _paused internal state.
Have paused() return value of an always-true expression (_paused || true) causing it to always be true.
Have paused() return value of an always-false expression (_paused && false) causing it to always be false.
Change setKeeper to emit KeeperUpdated but do not update the keeper state variable (omit assignment), causing keeper to remain unchanged after a call.
Change setKeeper to set keeper to the zero address instead of the provided address.
Change setKeeper to set keeper to msg.sender instead of the provided address.
Modify onlyOwner modifier to allow any caller (remove owner check), letting non-owner callers call setKeeper and thus possibly change keeper to different addresses.
